Context: 11. Guidelines for Reviewing.-

- (ii) To ensure correct Reporting.Reviewing Officer to carefully see that Reporting has been done as per instructions/ guidelines. If any vague/ ambiguous remarks are contained, the report to be returned to the Reporting Officer for necessary revision. If the Reviewing Officer disagrees with any part of the report, he may state so with suitable remarks. If he "agrees with the assessment of the Reporting Officer", his remarks should not be at variance with the report.
